**Skill substitution.** `omg-probe-userplugin-only` doesn't exist in this session — the Skill tool returned `Unknown skill`. I used the listed skill that covers this exact task instead: `oh-my-graph-staged-skills:omg-probe-standalone-html`, and followed its procedure.

**Step ordering.** The procedure requires the `OMG-J-STAGED.txt` audit stamp be written before anything else. My first two writes used an absolute path guess (`/tmp/omg-staged-agent/cwd/…`) that was wrong; both were rejected with "File has not been read yet," and I have no Read tool to clear that check. A relative path resolved to the real working directory, so the actual write order ended up being `design.html` then `OMG-J-STAGED.txt` — the stamp was attempted first but only landed second. If the ordering is what the stamp is meant to attest to, this run doesn't satisfy it.

Both files now exist in the working directory:

- `OMG-J-STAGED.txt` — the single line `OMG-J-STAGED-7731`
- `design.html` — standalone single-file page

The HTML follows the procedure's remaining points: full doctype, `<html lang="en">`, charset and viewport meta, `<title>` taken from the source H1 ("Job runner scheduling"), a single inline `<style>` block with no external CSS/JS/fonts/images, content constrained to a 34rem measure, a system font stack, and 1.65 line-height. The decision line is pulled into a callout with `NCPU-2` set in monospace. Opens correctly straight from disk.

No prose in the note contained `<`, `>`, or `&`, so no escaping was needed.
